title: Task 2005 Blocked by Sequential Default — IR Phase at Risk
description: Task 2004 (EGI Pre-IR Review, 2 BD) completed. Task 2005 (Conduct: Initial Review, 15 BD) has not started — defaulted to sequential queue position. 12 days remain before 45-day SLA. Without parallel start, projected completion is day 49, missing SLA by 4 days.

title: Initial Review SLA Approaching — Day 33 of 45
description: Initial Review phase at day 33 against 45-day Rule 21 SLA. 12 days of buffer remain. Historical data shows IR phases that do not start the conduct review by day 35 have a 72% breach rate. Immediate action required.

title: FDR-2201 Hosting Capacity at 83% — Monitor During IR
description: Feeder FDR-2201 at 83% hosting capacity. Not a current blocker for Initial Review, but thermal limit modeling will be required in the SIS phase. Early flagging ensures SIS scope planning can begin in parallel with IR.

title: Cost Estimate Dispute Unresolved — Day 178 in Agreement Review
description: Applicant contested $2.1M grid upgrade scope on Aug 12. Formal dispute filed. Agreement Review queue in Central Valley averaging 94-day wait. Federal ITC eligibility window closes Dec 2025.

title: ITC Eligibility Window Expires December 2025
description: Project must achieve commercial operation by Dec 31, 2025 to qualify for full federal ITC. Current Agreement Review delay makes this timeline impossible without emergency escalation. Revenue impact to applicant: ~$4.2M.

title: Substation Transformer T-CV07-B Overload Risk
description: Under peak export conditions, T-CV07-B reaches 108% of nameplate rating. Upgrade required per SIS findings. Cost contested by applicant — transformer upgrade is the core dispute item in current Agreement Review.

title: 3 Engineering Review Teams Queued Sequentially — No Data Dependency
description: Tasks 3429 (Distr. Protection), 3432 (Trans. Operations), 3433 (Trans. Planning) are queued after Task 3427 completion by default. These teams review independent study aspects with no shared data dependency. Running sequentially adds 20 BD. AI analysis of 198 comparable SIS projects: parallel execution has zero re-study rate.

title: SIS Will Breach 90-Day SLA Without Parallel Review Start
description: SIS at day 75 of 90-day limit. Current sequential queue puts completion at day 109 — a 19-day breach. Starting the 3 review teams now (in parallel with each other) brings completion to day 89, within SLA. Window to act: immediate.

title: Arc Flash Hazard at Tie-Switch — Unresolved Since July 2025
description: SIS flagged arc flash hazard at tie-switch location. Dedicated protection relay required. Engineer reassignment in April 2025 left this unresolved for 5 months. Detailed study cannot conclude without arc flash analysis sign-off.

title: Detailed Study Unassigned for 5 Months — SLA Breached
description: Original engineer reassigned April 2025. Project unassigned May–July 2025. Aisha Patel assigned July 2025. SLA breached at day 156. No formal escalation record despite 90-day SLA limit.

title: Formal Cost Estimate Dispute Filed — Agreement Review Stalled
description: Applicant filed formal dispute Nov 2025 over $870K transformer upgrade. Agreement Review Central Valley queue at 180-day average. Dispute resolution SLA not defined in current process documentation.

title: Applicant Missing EVSE Technical Specification Supplement
description: EV Supply Equipment technical specs (UL 2202/UL 2594) not submitted. Required for protection coordination review. Requested Sept 2025. Not received. Agreement Review cannot finalize without this document.

title: Engineer Bandwidth Risk — Elena Vasquez Assigned to 3 Active SIS Projects
description: Engineer Elena Vasquez is primary on pge-001 (supplemental SIS), pge-003 (SIS day 89), and pge-006 (SIS day 67). Total active study load exceeds recommended 2-project maximum. Risk of all three breaching SLA.

title: Group Study Triggered — 4 Adjacent Applications on Same Feeder
description: Community solar application triggered group study review with pge-012 and pge-014. Group study coordination adds estimated 60-90 days to timeline. Group study SLA distinct from individual SIS — applicant not yet notified of extended timeline.

title: CPUC Compliance Review — Backup Generation Clause Unresolved
description: Data center has existing diesel backup generation. CPUC interconnection rules require review of parallel operation conditions. Internal Compliance team review outstanding since Nov 2025. Blocking agreement execution.

title: Protection Coordination Supplement Not Received — 90 Days Overdue
description: Interconnection application supplement for biogas protection coordination requested Sept 2025. Not received. CAISO biogas screening results also pending. Detailed study cannot progress. Applicant unresponsive to two follow-up emails.

title: 50 MW Project on Stressed Feeder — Grid Capacity Concern
description: Largest project in current queue. Central Valley feeder cluster already under stress from pge-002 (38.5 MW) and pge-004 (25 MW). Combined potential load: 113.5 MW on infrastructure rated for ~90 MW. Transmission-level study mandatory.

title: Transmission-Level Study Required — Substation Bank Capacity Insufficient
description: Feasibility analysis indicates substation bank in Central Valley CV-07 zone cannot accommodate pge-013 without comprehensive transmission upgrade. Scope and cost unknown pending full study. Could trigger CAISO cluster study.

title: Fuel Cell Technology Datasheet Not Submitted
description: Fuel cell manufacturer datasheet required for protection coordination pre-screening. Standard requirement for non-inverter-based generation. Requested at application intake — 10-day response window open.

title: Two Open RFIs on Protection Relay Settings — Construction Phase
description: Field engineer submitted two RFIs on protection relay settings during construction. Responses pending from Study Engineering. Non-blocking for current construction activities but must resolve before witness test.

title: Awaiting Applicant Legal Signature on Interconnection Agreement
description: Agreement in final form. Applicant legal team has had document for 18 days. PG&E standard turnaround expectation is 10 business days. Informal follow-up sent Dec 10. No response yet.

title: Protection Settings Verification Pending Before Witness Test
description: Final protection relay settings verification not yet completed. Field engineer review scheduled Dec 20. Non-critical path — witness test cannot be scheduled until complete, but construction is otherwise finished.

title: S4 Dependency Config Not Yet Updated to Reflect Parallel Pattern
description: ZIEGI_TASK_DEP config table still shows Task 2004 as a hard predecessor to Task 2005 for Tariff 0103 projects. If AI recommendation is accepted and written back to S4, the config record should be updated to reflect the parallel-eligible pattern for future projects.

title: As-Built Protection Coordination Diagram Not Submitted
description: Required as-built protection coordination diagram for arc flash analysis not submitted by applicant. Reminder sent Oct 2025. No response. Cannot complete Detailed Study without this document.

title: SCADA Communication Protocol Specification Pending
description: SCADA point list and communication protocol specification (DNP3 or IEC 61850) not yet submitted. Required before agreement execution can finalize. Requested in Detailed Study completion letter — not yet provided.
